nse:106830108.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106830108.answer: Management guided in November 2025 (Q2 FY26 call) to FY26 revenue of ~₹12,500 crore with 15%+ average margins, noting lower margins on Coast Guard/ONGC/offshore orders. Q2 FY27 actuals show revenue dropping 16.5% YoY to ₹2,446.1 crore and EBITDA margin falling to 8.1%, below management's long-term 15% baseline guidance.

evidence.quote: We anticipate that this year, we will have revenue of approximately INR 12,500 crores or so
Thereafter, we will have may be a few months where we'll have only the Coast Guard and the MPV project as well as the offshore project where the margins are slightly less
But on an average, we can anticipate around 15% plus margins

nse:106823051.question: What has management said about this on its recent calls?
nse:106823051.answer: Management did not discuss any distrust of intermediate CAs, root CA distrust, or key generation flaws. The closest discussion occurred in the Q4 FY26 call, where management stated that a Google policy change regarding multi-purpose and new root certificates had no impact because existing roots remained trusted while new roots were queued.

evidence.quote: Our new roots have been submitted some time back

So, nothing stops for us because our existing roots are already trusted on Google and we basically have a transition period where the existing roots will continue to work until the new roots are accepted by Google
So, there is really no impact as such

nse:106830133.question: What has management said about raising money: how much, why, and what it is for?
nse:106830133.answer: Management did not discuss raising money or issuing credit facilities in either call. In May 2025, management stated that the company holds Rs. 11,000 to Rs. 12,000 crores in cash and does not expect to take on debt for capex due to a healthy balance sheet, adding in October 2025 that it does not have much borrowings.

evidence.quote: As of now, we are having quite healthy Balance Sheet and we do not expect, but it will be based on the economic performance, we will see
I don't think it will be having any impact because we are not having any much borrowings, so it is almost the same

nse:106834087.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106834087.answer: In July 2026 (Q1 FY27 call), management maintained guidance for full-year volume growth at 8% to 10% and PBDIT margins at 18% to 20%. The reported Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin of 15.6% missed this margin guidance range, although revenue grew 16.9% YoY to ₹9,976.5 crore.

evidence.quote: At the current stage, we are looking at the band of 8-10% for the full FY27
We are still garnering around the guidance of 18-20% of our PBDIT margins holds

nse:106829089.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106829089.answer: In May 2026 (Q4 FY26), management stated it would accelerate growth in both revenues and EBITDA in FY27. In August 2026 (Q1 FY27), management declined to provide specific financial guidance, but noted Bluetile's consolidation starting Q2 FY27 would add scale. The Q2 FY27 results match this, with revenue growing 52.6% YoY and EBITDA rising 88.8% YoY.

evidence.quote: and we will continue to accelerate growth both in revenues and EBITDA in FY '27
And subject to the final closing, we are expecting to start consolidating this entire business from Q2 FY27
At Nazara level, do we want to give any guidance in terms of revenue, EBITDA, or margin? Nitish Mittersain: Not at this point of time

nse:106823393.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106823393.answer: Management did not give specific revenue or margin guidance for Q2 FY27, stating in July 2026 that they had "no guidance on that." They provided broader directional views, expecting food delivery margins to remain flattish over the next 1–2 years (October 2026) and quick commerce long-term Adjusted EBITDA margins to reach 6% (July 2026).

evidence.quote: Sorry, Swapnil, we don't want to comment on the quarter right now, no guidance on that
Directionally, we want to maintain margins broadly and reinvest in growth as much as it makes sense to continue to drive the growth upwards
It's hard to project or comment on margin trajectory every quarter but broadly, over the next 1 or 2 years, we expect the margins to remain flattish

nse:106818661.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106818661.answer: In June 2026, management stated that a major $650 million deal would be revenue and margin accretive starting Q2 FY27. They also maintained an aspirational EBIT margin target of 16% to 17%. The 30.3% YoY revenue growth matched growth expectations, but Q2 EBIT margin came in lower at 15% due to wage hikes and deal amortization.

evidence.quote: And yes, it will be accretive - revenue & margin from Q2 onwards
Yeah, so from our perspective we have said we want to be in the 16 to 17 % range, that is our aspiration
EBIT margins for Q2 FY27 came in at 15%, 130 basis points declined year-on-year

nse:106810133.question: What has management said about debt, leverage and its credit profile?
nse:106810133.answer: In February 2026, management reported gross long-term debt of ~INR 78,000 crores and total external debt of ~INR 62,000 crores. In April 2026, CFO Robbie Singh stated overall leverage stood at 3.9x and is expected to remain flat or decrease slightly, guiding core infrastructure leverage to a 3.5x to 4.5x range while maintaining conservative mining leverage.

evidence.quote: the 3.9x is likely to remain either flat or slightly down
we guide to that in the core infra while we are growing, we will be closer to the 3.5 to 4.5 range.
So the external debt of that would be ~INR 62,000 crores

nse:106805308.question: What has management said on recent calls about leadership, succession or this role?
nse:106805308.answer: In October 2026 (Q2 FY27), Sashidhar Jagdishan welcomed Anup Bagchi as the incoming MD and CEO as Jagdishan's tenure ended. Bagchi stated he would gather stakeholder insights and present his strategic perspective soon. Management also announced Deputy MD Kaizad Bharucha's early retirement effective December 2026. In July 2026 (Q1 FY27), leadership welcomed new Chairman Rajiv Kumar.

evidence.quote: As my long innings at HDFC Bank come to an end, I would like to say that it has been an absolute privilege to lead this organization that brings together some of the most brilliant minds and over 200,000 extremely committed and focused professionals, a cutting-edge technology, a solid brand that binds the 100 million customers, and a collective zeal to consistently deliver top-class results for all our stakeholders
I'm really grateful to the Board for the trust placed in me as MD and CEO
as we were in the call, I think the world would have just got another notification to the exchanges that our dear colleague, Kaizad, has requested for an early retirement by end of December

nse:106834360.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106834360.answer: In July 2026, management guided Q2 FY27 unit passenger revenue (PRASK) growth of over 25% year-over-year. The filing shows Q2 FY27 revenue rose 25.9% to ₹23,363.8 crore. However, management did not provide specific margin targets, though EBITDA margin improved to 8.2% from 3.1% YoY, despite a net loss of ₹1,879.1 crore.

evidence.quote: In terms of unit passenger revenue or PRASK for Q2FY27, with the current balanced demand￾supply equation and the higher fares holding up, we are expecting growth of more than 25% compared to the same period last year

nse:106830187.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106830187.answer: In the Q4 FY26 call, management did not provide specific revenue or margin targets for Q2 FY27. They declined to give explicit margin guidance due to dynamic cost headwinds and geopolitical uncertainties, but stated they expect Maruti Suzuki's overall sales volume to grow by over 10% in FY27 and return to a healthy margin trajectory once disruptions ease.

evidence.quote: The broad expectation, which our Chairman also conveyed, is growth of over 10% this year as compared to the last year
So it's always difficult to give out a guidance on margins
So we are very confident and optimistic that subject to these headwinds of the war, the commodities and the energy prices, after that is over, we'll come back to a healthy trajectory

nse:106821168.question: What has management said on recent calls about leadership, succession or this role?
nse:106821168.answer: In October 2026, outgoing CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan welcomed incoming MD and CEO Anup Bagchi and announced that Deputy Managing Director Kaizad Bharucha requested early retirement effective December 2026. In July 2026, Jagdishan welcomed new Chairman Rajiv Kumar and noted that the Board was actively addressing the process to enhance Whole-Time Directors on the Board.
